content:
hannah: Heads-up — opened PR #492 to clean up the docs examples around JSON response patterns, function/tool-calling examples, and a few edge-case parsing notes. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492 :eyes:
ryan: Thanks. Which pages are impacted?
hannah: /docs/guides/response-format.md, /docs/reference/function-calling.md, and snippets under /examples/sdk. Also fixed a bad anchor in the TOC.
olga: Quick note: some of our model variants now return extra metadata fields (e.g., __debug_token_info). We should show how to ignore unknown keys in schema validation rather than fail.
michael: Will update the JS + TS snippets. Plan: show both schema-based function call and a lightweight parser fallback.
michael: Example JS snippet I’ll add:
```js
// parse structured output safely
const schema = { type: 'object', properties: { result: { type: 'object' } }, additionalProperties: true }
const parsed = safeParseJson(responseText)
if (!validate(schema, parsed)) throw new Error('unexpected response shape')
```
elaine: Can you include the compact streaming example too? we had a customer question where the streaming response emitted fragments that broke naive JSON.parse.
hannah: Good call. I added a short explanation about buffered-assembly for streams and linked to the stream-assembly util in examples (examples/stream-utils.js).
olga: Also adding a small guardrail: recommend the server wrap final payload in a top-level envelope { version, payload } so we can evolve the payload shape without breaking clients.
ryan: We should add a migration note for teams pinned to v1.2 behavior. Suggest: show old vs new example and a one-liner to toggle legacy parsing mode in SDK.
michael: I'll add `sdk.parseLegacyResponses = true` snippet for Python + JS.
ci-bot: docs-lint: link-check failed for https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/docs/reference/function-calling.md#examples - anchor not found in current branch.
hannah: Fix pushed — renamed anchor to #function-calling-examples and updated the cross-links.
michael: PR updated with JS and TS snippets, left TODO for Python snippet (will add tomorrow). Requesting review from @elaine. :thumbsup:
elaine: Reviewing now, left one nit about wording around "additionalProperties" — prefer wording: "allow unknown keys but validate required ones."
olga: I'll add a tiny unit test under tests/examples to run the example through our parser and assert the parsed shape, so examples can't regress.
hannah: Nice. Can we also add a short manual QA checklist in the PR description so that reviewers validate streaming, schema, and SDK snippet parity?
ryan: +1. Also add a simple golden-response file so CI can compare output.
michael: Added golden and updated PR description.
ci-bot: checks/ci passed — examples unit tests green.
hannah: Merging once CI finishes. Thanks all — this should clear up a lot of customer confusion around structured outputs and tool calls.
